thread:
oliver_fin: Flagging a dispute from Nimbus Analytics on INV-2026-501 (private deployment renewal). They say platform fee appears as a one-time "amortized" charge plus the annual platform fee, effectively double-billing them for the same period. cc @meera_csm

meera_csm: Customer sent PDF. Lines: PLATFORM_FEE_ANNUAL $18,000; PLATFORM_FEE_AMORTIZED $9,000. Their contract shows a single annual platform fee of $18k and a financed amortization option was NOT selected in SOW.

billing-bot: Retrieved invoice lines for INV-2026-501: ["PLATFORM_FEE_ANNUAL: 18000", "PLATFORM_FEE_AMORTIZED: 9000", "SUPPORT_STANDARD: 6000", "USAGE: 3200"]. Billing notes: amortized flag set=true on invoice generation. Source: billing-job-2026-03-27.

oliver_fin: How did amortized flag get set? We need to know if customer was charged erroneously or if a previous agreement exists.

billing-bot: Audit: amortized_flag toggled by billing-svc in run 2026-03-26 when processing renewal queue for customer=nimbus-analytics. No manual override recorded. Last SOW check shows financing_option=null.

meera_csm: Nimbus insists they never opted into amortization and they have an email thread to prove it. They've paused payment and want credits. They asked for an adjusted invoice and refund of the $9k amortized charge.

legal-bot: Contract check passed. Clause 4.2 - amortization requires signed addendum. No addendum found for Nimbus. Recommend issuing provisional refund for the $9,000 and flagging invoice as disputed. Request controller sign-off for refunds > $5k.

cecil_controller: I can approve provisional refund up to $10k if ops provides root cause and remediation plan. Need JIRA billing ticket and audit trail attached to memo.

oliver_fin: Proposed actions: 1) Issue provisional credit note CM-2026-123 for $9,000 "provisional - disputed amortized fee". 2) Mark invoice INV-2026-501 as disputed and set payment_hold. 3) Open BUG billing-BUG-332 to investigate automated amortization toggle. 4) Notify customer with timeline.

meera_csm: Draft customer message:

Hi Nimbus team,

Thanks for flagging this. We're investigating an internal billing error that caused an amortized platform fee to be applied in error. We've placed your invoice on hold and will issue a provisional credit for $9,000 while we reconcile. Expect an updated invoice and detailed audit within 3 business days. Sorry for the inconvenience.

— Meera (Customer Success)

billing-bot: Created credit memo CM-2026-123, status pending_controller_approval. Created ticket billing-BUG-332. Attached audit logs.

cecil_controller: Approved CM-2026-123 provisional credit. Please include note: "controller approved provisional refund subject to reconciliation".

oliver_fin: Noting this thread for audit trail. Follow-up: confirm remediation PR merged and no other customers affected before finalizing credit.
